newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras hits possibly huge wells.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras hits possibly huge wells.

text.p: Brazilian state oil company Petrobras has struck two new oil wells in the Campos Basin, off the Rio de Janeiro coast, which could lead to an important oil discovery, the company said in a statement.
The wells, Rio de Janeiro Submarino 436 and Rio de Janeiro Submarino 511 are in deep waters, around 130 kilometers from the Rio de Janeiro coast.

The first well, where oil has been discovered from a depth of 3,229 meters, could add 400 million to 600 million barrels to total reserves, suggesting another gigantic basin to add to the Marlim, Albacora and Barracuda basins already in the area.
The second well could hold a potential reserve of 30 million to 40 million barrels from a depth of 2,673 meters.
Brazilian oil and gas reserves reached 11 billion barrels at the end of 1995, of which 4.8 billion were of oil.
The two wells are being evaluated and a better idea of their potential should be available in 1997, the company said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
